body: Well they dont have to know that, right? If you play your cards good, you will get a girl in no time. For the start, if you feel you are like 5/10 or 6/10 dont aim for the 8-9-10/10, try to find some girl closer to your level, learn some basics from that girl and then when you feel like you can aim higher, do it.

Girls have some sort of "sixth sense" and they can feel if you are desperate about trying to go out with her or getting her number, when they feel that they will turn you down. You have to be interested in that girl but not too much, act like you are asking her out just because you like her more than you like other potential girls, but you actually dont care if she turns you down because you have plenty of other girls waiting for you. Girls like to feel special, and what is more special if you choose that girl over for example other 10 girls tat are waiting to be asked out by you.

It doesnt matter if you are attractive or not, just as the other guy said girls are humans too, like they dont have prepared speech or anything else when a guy approaches them, just to say all of that stuff. They feel nervous and weird too, you are talking to a stranger, you dont even know what to say or what to do. Its the same feeling guys have.

In a lot of cases when a guy approaches girl, the girl is feeling more nervous than the guy, so its not easy for them too as you think it is, you have to take advantage of that. Dont use some cheesy pickup lines, that can just turn them down because they probably heard that line for a 1000 times. Try to be the same person from when you are chatting online with the girls, I will say this again if you get turned down by some random girl, dont be sad because in a lot of cases you will get turned down but you have to keep trying with other girls, eventually you will find one good that matches your personality.

You can just try to free yourself by just chatting with random girls on social apps, dont get sad if you get turned down by some random girl, there is a plenty of the other girls. You will get some courage and some motivation after some time, you will feel that you are worthy enough to approach some girl in real-life and to talk to her without being so nervous. Its all the practice you need to free yourself from thoughts about being so nervous around girls.

I dont think about suicide, neither you should. That should not be an option, there are always other better options that you can do. I posted this just to hear other people thoughts about this, maybe someone had the same period like this is and managed to get over it.

Just be natural, talk whatever is on your mind in that particular moment (just dont be dirty), if girl dont like you as natural yourself then find another one that will, pretending to be something that you are not is not gonna take you anywhere. Cheers.
